# Background email campaigns

*Client industry: media | Completed: 2024-10-15 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p17*

## The problem
The client was a newsletter platform whose sends blocked the web app.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using a batteries-included Python web framework, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project sent 400k emails a day without slowing the UI.
